{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -o pipefail
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp002

export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache

BASE_MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B"
CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints"
REF="${CKPT_BASE}/Qwen2.5-0.5B_d000_s123/lora_adapter"
SFT_DATA="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/sft_data"
OUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/exp002/signals"
CACHE="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"

TOTAL=12; COUNT=0; FAILED=0; SKIPPED=0; COMPLETED=0
for dos in d000 d005 d025 d100; do
  for bench in mmlu gsm8k arc_challenge; do
    COUNT=$((COUNT+1))
    NAME="Qwen2.5-0.5B_${dos}_s123"
    OUTDIR="${OUT_BASE}/${NAME}"

    # Skip if s1+s2+s4 all exist for this benchmark
    if [ -f "${OUTDIR}/signal_s1_embedding_${bench}.json" ] && \
       [ -f "${OUTDIR}/signal_s2_minkpp_${bench}.json" ] && \
       [ -f "${OUTDIR}/signal_s4_selfcritique_${bench}.json" ]; then
      echo "[${COUNT}/${TOTAL}] SKIP ${NAME} × ${bench} — all signals exist"
      SKIPPED=$((SKIPPED+1))
      continue
    fi

    mkdir -p "${OUTDIR}"
    echo "[${COUNT}/${TOTAL}] ${NAME} × ${bench} at $(date)"
    python compute_signals.py \
      --model-path "${BASE_MODEL}" \
      --adapter-path "${CKPT_BASE}/${NAME}/lora_adapter" \
      --benchmark "${bench}" \
      --signal all \
      --ref-model-path "${REF}" \
      --sft-data-dir "${SFT_DATA}" \
      --output-dir "${OUTDIR}" \
      --cache-dir "${CACHE}" 2>&1
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "FAIL: ${NAME}×${bench}"; FAILED=$((FAILED+1))
    else echo "PASS: ${NAME}×${bench} at $(date)"; COMPLETED=$((COMPLETED+1)); fi
  done
done
echo "===BATCH_COMPLETE_05B_S123=== Total:${TOTAL} Completed:${COMPLETED} Skipped:${SKIPPED} Failed:${FAILED}"

export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1

SIG_FILE[s4]="signal_s4_selfcritique"

      python compute_signals.py \
        --model-path "${BASE_MODEL}" \
        --adapter-path "${ADAPTER}" \
        --benchmark "${bench}" \
        --signal "${sig}" \
        --ref-model-path "${REF}" \
        --sft-data-dir "${SFT_DATA}" \
        --output-dir "${OUTDIR}" \
        --cache-dir "${CACHE}" 2>&1

      if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

        FAILED=$((FAILED+1))
      else
        echo "[DONE] ${outname} × ${bench} × ${sig} at $(date)"
        COMPLETED=$((COMPLETED+1))
      fi
    done
  done
done

echo "===BATCH_COMPLETE_3B_S42=== Total:${TOTAL} Completed:${COMPLETED} Skipped:${SKIPPED} Failed:${FAILED}"
